data.title: ALT to Unlock $1.13 Million in Tokens in One Week
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing RootData, AltLayer (ALT) is scheduled to unlock approximately 246.59 million tokens, valued at about $1.13 million, on November 26 at 8:00 AM (UTC+8).

data.title: OpenAI President Greg Brockman Says Cybersecurity Business Will Surpass Coding
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, OpenAI President Greg Brockman said the company’s cybersecurity business will eventually surpass its coding business. He said he is currently in “full management mode,” overseeing day-to-day operations and prioritizing enterprise customers and cybersecurity. Cybersecurity is already an important, fast-growing revenue source for OpenAI, though Brockman did not disclose figures.

OpenAI has launched a dedicated cybersecurity model and a red-teaming agent, and its Daybreak project provides tools to businesses, governments, and security professionals. Thibault Sottiaux, who leads OpenAI’s product and platform teams, said Brockman took part in the decision to delay a model that did not meet safety standards. Sottiaux also said Brockman authorized pausing about a quarter of product work for several weeks to reassign engineers to internal security infrastructure.

data.title: GTA 6 Reviews and Record Launch Audience Lift Take-Two Shares
data.description: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) launched worldwide on Thursday across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, drawing a record livestream audience and a near-perfect critical score that pushed Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ: TTWO) shares higher.Critical receptionThe game opened at 99 on Metacritic across 146 critic reviews, tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the site's highest-rated game. Reviewers at IGN and Vice called it the most impressive game they had played, with reporter Brent Koepp describing it as "possibly the best open-world game ever made" after more than 130 hours of play.Audience and preordersStreams Charts recorded nearly 7.9 million simultaneous viewers within three hours of the first release, the largest livestream audience it has tracked for a game launch. TwitchTracker put GTA VI at roughly 2.46 million viewers on Twitch, about 66% of the platform's concurrent viewership at the time. Sensor Tower estimates 17.07 million digital preorders.Stock reactionTake-Two rose as much as 7.35% to $218.91 in Wednesday trading before closing at $216.61, up about 6%. The stock remains down roughly 15% year to date despite the run-up into launch.Wells Fargo raised its sales forecast to about 65 million copies by the end of March, nearly double its earlier 35 million estimate, and lifted its annual net bookings projection 19% to $9.76 billion.

data.title: RRJ Capital-Led Consortium Agrees to Buy $619 Million of GM3 Bonds
data.description: According to Bloomberg, a consortium led by private investment firm RRJ Capital agreed to buy $619 million of bonds from Australian coking coal miner GM3, people familiar with the matter said.

data.title: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda Optimistic on Consumption Despite Recent Weakness
data.description: According to Jin10, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said Thursday that consumption is expected to recover after a brief slowdown. He added that the decline in private spending in third-quarter GDP data was within the central bank’s expectations. Speaking in parliament, Ueda said nominal wages would rise steadily while inflation slows gradually, and that higher household income would support consumption. He said consumption remained resilient overall and that the third-quarter decline was mainly due to rising living costs and adverse weather. “We expect consumption to return to a moderate growth trend,” he said. The comments suggest that weak third-quarter consumption alone will not prevent the Bank of Japan from raising rates again in the near term.

data.title: AI | MAS Says Agents Could Move Funds Faster, Raising Financial Risks
data.description: Singapore’s central bank warned that artificial intelligence agents could move deposits and other funds more quickly, raising liquidity and financial-stability risks, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Nvidia Interim CEO Colette Kress Says “We’ve Got This” Three Times in 24 Hours
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing WIRED, Nvidia interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress used the phrase “We’ve got this” publicly three times in 24 hours, according to a Nov. 18 report. On Tuesday’s third-quarter earnings call, she said the company’s momentum was real, demand was accelerating and supply continued to grow, adding that customers, partners and employees stood with Nvidia.

Kress repeated the phrase at a company town hall on Wednesday, saying Nvidia’s innovation ambitions and commitments to customers, partners and shareholders would not change. She likened employees to a crowd singing together at a University of Florida football game. Nvidia Chairman Harvey Jones had previously said the board had no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang.

data.title: 'Parasite' Backer CJ ENM and South Korean Stocks Rally on China Trade Deal
data.description: According to CNBC, South Korean entertainment, gaming and travel stocks rallied Thursday after Seoul and Beijing concluded negotiations on an expanded trade agreement. Drama producer Studio Dragon surged 29.96%, CJ ENM, a backer of the film “Parasite,” rose 26%, travel agency Hana Tour gained 18% and film distributor Showbox advanced 9%. Gaming companies Krafton and Shift Up climbed 2.69% and 6.57%, respectively. The agreement would expand the countries’ free trade pact to cover services and investment, and give South Korean film and game businesses most-favored-nation treatment in China. The two sides also agreed to apply nondiscriminatory principles to reviews of online games and films and expand joint productions to television dramas, animation, variety shows and documentaries. The agreement has not been formally signed or taken effect; both countries are finalizing its technical wording.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Trump Says AI Is Almost Entirely Good and Vows to Oppose Rules That “Strangle” the Industry
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said artificial intelligence is almost entirely a good thing, though it has some negative aspects. According to Odaily, he opposes regulations that would “strangle” the AI industry and said he would never allow that to happen. Trump also said inflation had fallen to an unexpectedly low level over the past three months.

data.title: Altius Labs Takes Stake in edgeX to Build Shared All-Asset Trading Infrastructure
data.description: Blockchain infrastructure company Altius Labs, backed by Founders Fund, has acquired a stake in edgeX from Amber Group, becoming a strategic shareholder; Altius Labs co-founder and CEO Annabelle Huang will also join edgeX as a core contributor. According to Odaily, edgeX has served more than 500,000 users and recorded cumulative trading volume of over $1.1 trillion since launching in October 2024. The companies plan to combine edgeX’s trading platform and liquidity with Altius Labs’ infrastructure to develop a shared trading and liquidity network for exchanges, brokerages and other trading platforms worldwide. The network is intended to provide shared matching, clearing and settlement infrastructure for on-chain assets, letting partners expand tradable assets and access shared liquidity while retaining their brands and user relationships. edgeX plans to expand beyond crypto assets into tokenized stocks, commodities and foreign exchange, across spot and perpetual markets. It is developing a hybrid trading engine combining a central limit order book (CLOB) and request for quote (RFQ) functions to improve execution for major assets and liquidity in long-tail markets. Altius Labs focuses on high-performance blockchain infrastructure for trading and institutional finance and is also backed by Pantera Capital and Digital Currency Group.

data.title: Rakuten Yen Bond Spreads Expand After Potential Data Leak Ahead of New Sale
data.description: Rakuten Group Inc.’s yen bond spreads are widening after a major potential customer-data leak at a group brokerage, as the company prepares another large debt sale this month, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Kazuo Ueda: Wage Talks Key to Assessing Stable 2% Underlying Inflation
data.description: According to Jin10, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said he is closely monitoring next year's wage negotiations and views them as a key factor in determining whether underlying inflation can stabilize at 2%.

data.title: Wells Fargo: Australian Dollar Risks Erasing 2026 Gains as Rate-Cut Bets Rise
data.description: According to Jin10, weak employment data strengthened market expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia has ended its current rate-hiking cycle and will cut rates next year, leaving the Australian dollar close to erasing all its gains since 2026. AUD/USD fell as much as 0.6% to 0.6675, its lowest level since January 19. A further decline would erase the currency’s gains for 2026, leaving the Norwegian krone as the only G10 currency to have risen against the U.S. dollar this year. Chidu Narayanan, Wells Fargo’s head of Asia-Pacific macro strategy, said weak employment data had added to pressure on the Australian dollar. He said it could fall further given subdued risk appetite, the Reserve Bank of Australia’s hawkish stance having peaked, narrowing interest-rate differentials, and rising market expectations for rate cuts.

data.title: Web3Auth Launches Website to Check Wallet Impact and Asset Recovery Status
data.description: Web3Auth said in a post that it has launched a website where users can check whether their wallets were affected and view asset recovery statuses. According to Foresight News, details on the return of recovered assets will be shared through official channels in the future.

data.title: Claude for Microsoft 365 Weekly Users Below One-Tenth of Paid Copilot's
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing The Information, a November 16 report said Microsoft internal data showed Claude for Microsoft 365 had fewer than one-tenth as many weekly active users as the paid version of Microsoft 365 Copilot. The feature lets users apply Claude in Office apps for tasks such as organizing email and creating presentations. People familiar with the matter said its usage has fallen further behind Copilot in recent months, while Copilot use in Office has grown faster.

Claude for Microsoft 365 launched this May, giving Office customers the option to use Claude as an AI assistant. The report also said some Copilot features are powered by Anthropic models. Microsoft is preparing to showcase AI agent hosting and security features at Ignite and connect Office apps to the Copilot app.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump: Inflation Fell to an Unexpected Level Over the Past Three Months
data.description: According to Jin10, U.S. President Donald Trump said the inflation rate had fallen to an unexpected level over the past three months.

data.title: Nvidia Faces Risk of Losing Key Engineers After Jensen Huang's Ouster
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Business Insider, Nvidia faces a risk of losing key engineers after its board removed Jensen Huang last week. Melius Research technology analyst Ben Reitzes said ahead of Nvidia's earnings call that retaining engineers and maintaining the product roadmap are issues for the interim management team. Nvidia's market capitalization has fallen by about $500 billion since Huang's removal, the report said.

Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress told employees at an all-hands meeting on Wednesday that the company would bring forward salary increases and additional stock awards to December. Nvidia also said its technology plans and customer relationships remain stable. The board is considering internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. Thousands of employees have signed an open letter calling for Huang's reinstatement, while Nvidia robotics researcher Darrell Dai resigned after Huang's departure, the report said.

data.title: Sky Founder-Linked Wallet Borrows 77 Million USDS as Pool Liquidity Runs Out
data.description: A wallet linked to Sky founder Rune Christensen deposited about $185 million worth of SKY tokens as collateral on the Sky protocol and borrowed about 77 million USDS. According to Foresight News, on-chain analyst kirbycrypto said the borrowing represents nearly 50% of the protocol’s total value locked, while utilization has reached 100% and available liquidity for lender withdrawals has fallen to zero. Lenders must wait for repayments or new funds to enter the pool. The associated wallet has not actively repaid the debt for about six months, and its outstanding balance has continued to grow.

data.title: A-Cap Insurer Seeks to Delay Client Payouts Amid Sale Talks
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Advantage Capital Holdings’ main life insurer is seeking to defer certain customer payments while pursuing sale talks with a potential acquirer. The insurer has disputed a state regulator’s concerns about its financial strength.

data.title: GameStop CEO Criticizes Digital Releases Ahead of ‘GTA VI’ Launch
data.description: GameStop’s CEO criticized digital game releases on the eve of GTA VI’s launch, according to Bloomberg. The game is described as the biggest video game of all time, and GameStop as the largest standalone video game retailer.
